sql:
SELECT pa.defensive_work_rate
FROM Player_Attributes pa
JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name = 'Kevin Berigaud' AND pa.date = '2013-02-22 00:00:00'

SELECT strftime('%Y', '1991-10-21') - strftime('%Y', Birthday) AS Age
FROM Patient
WHERE ID = (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE Date = '1991-10-21' AND UA = 8.4
)

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM users u 
JOIN posts p ON u.Id = p.OwnerUserId 
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'Jay Stevens' 
AND STRFTIME('%Y', p.CreaionDate) = '2010'

SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) 
FROM Patient 
WHERE strftime('%Y', Birthday) = '1980' AND Diagnosis = 'RA'

SELECT MIN(TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, Birthday, `First Date`)) AS Age
FROM Patient

SELECT d.forename, d.surname
FROM drivers d
JOIN results r ON d.driverId = r.driverId
JOIN lapTimes lt ON d.driverId = lt.driverId
WHERE d.nationality = 'German' AND strftime('%Y', d.dob) BETWEEN '1980' AND '1990'
GROUP BY d.driverId
ORDER BY MIN(lt.time) ASC, COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 3

SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT T1.event_name) AS average_attendance
FROM event AS T1
INNER JOIN attendance AS T2 ON T1.event_id = T2.link_to_event
WHERE strftime('%Y', T1.event_date) = '2020' AND T1.type = 'Meeting'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT v.PostId) 
FROM votes v 
WHERE YEAR(v.CreationDate) = 2011 AND v.BountyAmount = 50

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ID) 
FROM Laboratory 
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', Date) = '1997' AND (TP < 6 OR TP > 8.5)

SELECT races.name, circuits.name, circuits.location 
FROM races 
JOIN circuits ON races.circuitId = circuits.circuitId 
WHERE strftime('%Y-%m', races.date) = '2005-09'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T1.`First Date` < '2000-01-01' AND (T2.SSA = '-' OR T2.SSA = '+-')

SELECT P.ID, P.SEX, strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) AS Age
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.GLU >= 180 AND L.`T-CHO` < 250

SELECT AVG(T2.overall_rating) AS average_overall_rating
FROM Player AS T1
JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
WHERE T1.player_name = 'Marko Arnautovic'
AND strftime('%Y-%m-%d', T2.date) BETWEEN '2007-02-22' AND '2016-04-21'

SELECT AdmEmail1, AdmEmail2 
FROM schools 
WHERE County = 'San Bernardino' 
  AND City = 'San Bernardino' 
  AND OpenDate BETWEEN '2009-01-01' AND '2010-12-31' 
  AND (SOC = '62' OR DOC = '54')

SELECT AVG(T3.cost) AS average_cost
FROM member AS T1
INNER JOIN expense AS T2 ON T1.member_id = T2.link_to_member
INNER JOIN event AS T4 ON T2.link_to_event = T4.event_id
WHERE T1.first_name = 'Elijah' AND T1.last_name = 'Allen'
AND (strftime('%m', T2.expense_date) = '09' OR strftime('%m', T2.expense_date) = '10')

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM drivers 
WHERE YEAR(dob) = 1980 AND nationality = 'British'

SELECT potential 
FROM Player_Attributes 
WHERE player_api_id = (
    SELECT player_api_id 
    FROM Player 
    WHERE player_name = 'Francesco Parravicini'
) 
AND date = '2010-08-30 00:00:00'

SELECT ta.buildUpPlayPassingClass
FROM Team_Attributes ta
JOIN Team t ON ta.team_api_id = t.team_api_id
WHERE t.team_long_name = 'FC Lorient' AND ta.date LIKE '2010-02-22%'

SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN STRFTIME('%Y', CreationDate) = '2010' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / 
    SUM(CASE WHEN STRFTIME('%Y', CreationDate) = '2011' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ratio
FROM votes

SELECT 
    m.home_team_goal AS final_score_home_team,
    m.away_team_goal AS final_score_away_team
FROM 
    Match m
JOIN 
    League l ON m.league_id = l.id
WHERE 
    m.date LIKE '2008-09-24%' AND
    l.name = 'Belgium Jupiler League'
SELECT driverRef FROM drivers WHERE nationality = 'German' ORDER BY dob ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT number FROM qualifying WHERE q3 = '1:54' AND raceId = 903

SELECT 
    (SUM(CASE WHEN Date LIKE '1981-11-%' THEN `T-CHO` ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN Date LIKE '1981-12-%' THEN `T-CHO` ELSE 0 END)) / 
    SUM(CASE WHEN Date LIKE '1981-11-%' THEN `T-CHO` ELSE 0 END) AS decrease_rate
FROM 
    Laboratory
JOIN 
    Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID
WHERE 
    Patient.Birthday = '1959-02-18'

SELECT event_name FROM event 
WHERE type = 'Game' AND status = 'Closed' 
AND event_date BETWEEN '2019-03-15T00:00:00' AND '2020-03-20T23:59:59'

SELECT c.constructorRef, c.url 
FROM constructors c 
JOIN results r ON c.constructorId = r.constructorId 
JOIN races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId 
WHERE ra.name = 'Singapore Grand Prix' AND ra.year = 2009 AND r.position = 1

SELECT p.player_name
FROM Player_Attributes pa
JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE pa.overall_rating = 77 AND pa.date LIKE '2016-06-23%'
ORDER BY p.birthday ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT d.forename, d.surname
FROM drivers d
JOIN pitStops ps ON d.driverId = ps.driverId
WHERE d.nationality = 'German' AND d.dob BETWEEN '1980-01-01' AND '1985-12-31'
GROUP BY d.driverId
ORDER BY AVG(ps.duration) ASC
LIMIT 3

SELECT DISTINCT T2.email 
FROM expense AS T1 
INNER JOIN member AS T2 ON T1.link_to_member = T2.member_id 
WHERE T1.expense_date BETWEEN '2019-09-10' AND '2019-11-19' AND T1.cost > 20

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT UserId) 
FROM badges 
WHERE Name = 'Commentator' AND STRFTIME('%Y', Date) = '2014'
SELECT T2.defensive_work_rate FROM Player AS T1 JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id WHERE T1.player_name = 'David Wilson'

SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN height < 180 AND overall_rating > 70 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM 
    Player_Attributes
SELECT preferred_foot FROM Player_Attributes ORDER BY potential ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT League.name 
FROM League 
JOIN Country ON League.country_id = Country.id 
WHERE Country.name = 'Germany'

SELECT c.name AS country_name, AVG(p.weight) AS avg_weight
FROM Player p
JOIN Country c ON p.player_api_id = (SELECT player_api_id FROM Player_Attributes WHERE date = (SELECT MAX(date) FROM Player_Attributes))
GROUP BY c.name
ORDER BY avg_weight DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Birthday
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.UN = 29

SELECT 
    (COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN ID ELSE NULL END) - COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN ID ELSE NULL END)) AS Deviation,
    CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN ID ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(ID) AS InpatientPercentage,
    CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN ID ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(ID) AS OutpatientPercentage
FROM 
    Patient
WHERE 
    SEX = 'M'

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM Examination 
WHERE `Examination Date` > '1997-01-01' AND APTT >= 45

SELECT SEX 
FROM Patient 
WHERE Diagnosis = 'AORTITIS' 
ORDER BY `First Date` ASC 
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM Patient 
WHERE SEX = 'F' AND Diagnosis = 'APS'

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.Symptoms LIKE '%thrombocytopenia%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(CASE WHEN T2.Diagnosis LIKE '%SLE%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ID) 
FROM Laboratory 
WHERE APTT > 45 AND ID NOT IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT ID 
    FROM Examination 
    WHERE Thrombosis = 1
)
SELECT AVG(LDH) FROM Laboratory WHERE LDH < 500

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM badges 
JOIN users ON badges.UserId = users.Id 
WHERE badges.Name = 'Supporter' AND users.Age > 65

SELECT CAST(COUNT(b.Id) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT b.UserId) 
FROM badges b 
JOIN users u ON b.UserId = u.Id 
WHERE u.Views > 200

SELECT DISTINCT u.Age
FROM badges b
JOIN users u ON b.UserId = u.Id
WHERE u.Location = 'Vienna, Austria'

SELECT d.forename, d.surname
FROM drivers d
JOIN results r ON d.driverId = r.driverId
WHERE r.fastestLapSpeed IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY CAST(r.fastestLapSpeed AS REAL) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT d.forename, d.surname
FROM drivers d
JOIN results r ON d.driverId = r.driverId
WHERE r.raceId = 872 AND r.time IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY d.dob DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM results 
JOIN races ON results.raceId = races.raceId 
WHERE races.name = 'Bahrain Grand Prix' AND races.year = 2007 AND results.time IS NULL

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM races 
JOIN circuits ON races.circuitId = circuits.circuitId 
WHERE races.year = 2010 AND circuits.country NOT IN ('Asia', 'Europe')

SELECT d.forename, d.surname
FROM drivers d
JOIN results r ON d.driverId = r.driverId
WHERE r.fastestLapTime IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY r.fastestLapTime ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT raceId, COUNT(*) AS num_finishers
FROM results
WHERE time IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY raceId
ORDER BY num_finishers DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT b.budget_id, b.category, MAX(e.cost) AS max_cost
FROM budget b
JOIN expense e ON b.budget_id = e.link_to_budget
WHERE e.expense_description LIKE '%Water, chips, cookies%'
GROUP BY b.budget_id, b.category
ORDER BY max_cost DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT T2.expense_description 
FROM member AS T1 
INNER JOIN expense AS T2 ON T1.member_id = T2.link_to_member 
WHERE T1.first_name = 'Sacha' AND T1.last_name = 'Harrison'

SELECT SUM(amount) 
FROM income 
WHERE link_to_member = (
    SELECT member_id 
    FROM member 
    WHERE first_name = 'Grant' AND last_name = 'Gilmour'
)

SELECT SUM(amount) 
FROM income 
WHERE link_to_member IN (
    SELECT member_id 
    FROM member 
    WHERE position = 'Vice President'
)

SELECT Phone, Ext, School 
FROM schools 
WHERE Zip = '95203-3704'
